correctness.rationale: Inclusion-exclusion sums F(p)=sum_{B proper}(-1)^(n-|B|+1)/(1-r_B(p)). Twice differentiating gives the incidence-matrix quadratic form with denominators (1-C(b,s)/C(n,s))^3. Boolean-lattice up/down decomposition yields harmonic level j eigenvalue 2 sum_b(-1)^(n-b+1) C(b-j,s-j) C(n-s-j,b-s)/(1-C(b,s)/C(n,s))^3 and multiplicity C(n,j)-C(n,j-1). Reindex b=s+k and use N=n-s-j to obtain lambda_j=2(-1)^(j+1) Delta^N[A(k)/(1-P(k))^3] at k=0. Nonnegative forward differences of binomial P,A, with strictness from the P(k)^N coefficient, establish every alternating sign for all n>=3,1<=s<n. Independent exact Fraction check gave (n,s)=(4,2): 3568/125,-432/125 and correct signs for (5,2),(6,3),(7,4). Boundary s=1,n-1 positive level1 only; nontrivial regimes have j1 and j2. Finite rational checks do not replace infinite finite-difference argument.
